preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the graph is between 1 and 100, inclusive.
The number of edges in the graph is between 0 and the maximum possible number of edges in a graph with n vertices, inclusive.
Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the graph.
No edge connects a vertex to itself.

preconditions.expression: Each pair of vertices is connected by at most one edge.
preconditions.description: The graph contains no multiple edges.

invariants.expression: all(x in range(1, n + 1) for x, y in edges)
invariants.description: Each edge connects two vertices within the graph.

invariants.expression: all(y in range(1, n + 1) for x, y in edges)
invariants.description: Each edge connects two vertices within the graph.

invariants.expression: all(x != y for x, y in edges)
invariants.description: No edge connects a vertex to itself.

invariants.expression: all(edges.count((x, y)) == 1 for x, y in edges)
invariants.description: Each pair of vertices is connected by at most one edge.

invariants.expression: all(x in range(1, n + 1) for x in roots)
invariants.description: Each root is a vertex within the graph.

invariants.expression: all(y in range(1, n + 1) for y in roots)
invariants.description: Each root is a vertex within the graph.

invariants.expression: all(x != y for x in roots for y in roots)

invariants.description: The graph must contain at least three roots to be considered Cthulhu.
Each tree in the graph must contain at least one vertex.

invariants.expression: all(len(edges) == len(trees) + len(roots) - 1 for trees, roots in possible_cthulhu)
invariants.description: The number of edges in the graph must be equal to the number of vertices in the trees plus the number of roots minus one.

invariants.expression: all(all(x in tree for x in roots) or all(x not in tree for x in roots) for tree in trees)
invariants.description: Each tree must either contain all the roots or none of them.

invariants.expression: all(all(x in tree for x in roots) or all(y in tree for y in roots) for tree in trees for x, y in edges if x in tree and y not in tree)
invariants.description: Each tree must either contain all the roots or none of them, and each edge must connect vertices within the same tree.

invariants.expression: all(all(x in tree for x in roots) or all(y in tree for y in roots) for tree in trees for x, y in edges if y in tree and x not in tree)
invariants.description: Each tree must either contain all the roots or none of them, and each edge must connect vertices within the same tree.

invariants.expression: all(all(x in tree for x in roots) or all(y in tree for y in roots) for tree in trees for x, y in edges if x in tree and y in tree)
invariants.description: Each tree must either contain all the roots or none of them, and each edge must connect vertices within the same tree.

invariants.expression: all(all(x in tree for x in roots) or all(y in tree for y in roots) for tree in trees for x, y in edges if x not in tree and y not in tree)
invariants.description: Each tree must either contain all the roots or none of them, and each edge must connect vertices within the same tree.
